bagPolicy.summary: Backpacks aren't allowed at Vinyl. Small bags under 12 inches are allowed and will be searched, and every guest is subject to a magnetic or physical search.
bagPolicy.quote: NO BACKPACKS. You may bring small bags under 12 inches and they will be searched.

parking.summary: The Center Stage garage at 1374 West Peachtree Street is open for Vinyl shows and takes credit, debit and ParkMobile only, no cash. The Midtown Plaza Deck at 1360 Peachtree Street is another option you can reserve in advance. MARTA's Arts Center Station is 0.2 miles away along West Peachtree Street.
parking.quote: Center Stage Garage Parking (1374 West Peachtree Street) ... Open for Center Stage, The Loft and Vinyl shows ... Credit, Debit, ParkMobile Accepted – No Cash

rideshare.summary: For Uber, Lyft or taxi drop-off and pickup, use 17th Street between West Peachtree Street and Spring Street.
rideshare.quote: Uber / Lyft / Taxi: For your safety, please use 17th Street (b/w West Peachtree St & Spring St)

concessions.summary: Vinyl has its own bar, with snacks available, and some shows offer pizza. Major credit cards are accepted at the bars for most shows, and cash tips for bartenders are appreciated.
concessions.quote: Yes – Center Stage, The Loft, and Vinyl all have bars available for guests. Certain shows offer pizza and we have snacks available at the bar.

accessibility.summary: For accessible seating at Vinyl, call (404) 885-1365 or email info@rivalentertainment.com before your show.
accessibility.quote: Please call (404)885-1365 or email info@rivalentertainment.com for accessible seating.

reEntry.summary: Vinyl hasn't published re-entry details on its official site. Check your event page or contact the venue before you go.

ticketPickup.summary: The box office is open Monday through Friday, 10am to 5pm, and is cashless, taking major credit and debit cards only. Will call is at the entrance to each room, including Vinyl, and you'll need a valid photo ID. Unless a show says otherwise, all ages are welcome.
ticketPickup.quote: Will Call is located at the entrance to each room. You must provide a valid photo ID.

gates.summary: Doors open 1 hour before the time on your ticket. Vinyl is part of the Center Stage complex at 17th Street and West Peachtree Street in Midtown, where lines often form early.
gates.quote: Doors are scheduled to open 1 hour prior to the time on your ticket.
